Jwt._comment: VULN (insecure config + weak JWT): the signing secret is a predictable, human-chosen phrase committed in plain text in source control. Anyone who can read the repo reads this key and forges a valid Admin token. Real apps load a long RANDOM key from a secret manager / environment, never source control. (HS256 keys must be > 256 bits, so this is long enough to run but low-entropy and disclosed, which is the real-world weakness.)
